## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Full parallels are preserved across multiple early Buddhist monastic traditions, including the Pali *Bhikkhupātimokkha* and *Parivāra*, the Mahīśāsaka Vibhaṅga and Prātimokkha traditions in Chinese, the Mahāsāṅghika Vibhaṅga and Prātimokkha (Chinese and Sanskrit), the Lokottaravāda Sanskrit Bhikṣu-prātimokkha, the Kāśyapīya Prātimokkha in Chinese, and the Chinese translation of the *Upāliparipṛcchā*.
